messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly—and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Inspect & Clean** | Give it a thorough cleaning—wipe down strings, fretboard, body, and check for cracks or loose hardware. Replace worn-out parts if needed. | A well-maintained guitar looks more appealing and fetches higher prices. | | **2️⃣ Determine Condition** | Classify as *New/Like New*, *Excellent*, *Good*, *Fair*, or *Needs Repair*. Be honest! | Buyers trust transparency; misrepresentations lead to returns or bad reviews. | | **3️⃣ Research Market Value** | Search recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Etsy, and local classifieds for the same make/model/year. Use “sold” listings for accurate data. | Sets realistic expectations and protects against overpricing. | | **4️⃣ Take High‑Quality Photos** | • Front view
• Side view
• Close‑up of headstock, bridge, pickups (if applicable)
• Any damage or unique features | Great visuals attract buyers faster than text alone. | | **5️⃣ Write a Clear Listing** | Include:
- Brand + Model
- Year / Age
- Body wood/material
- Finish details
- String gauge/type
- Current tuning (or note)
- Accessories (case, strap, picks)
- Reason for selling | Detailed descriptions reduce questions and build buyer confidence. | | **6️⃣ Choose Your Platform(s)** | • **Reverb.com** – Guitar‑specific marketplace.
• **eBay** – Large audience, auction option.
• **Craigslist/Facebook Marketplace** – Local sale, no shipping hassles.
• **OfferUp / Letgo** – Mobile-friendly local buying/selling.
• **Local Music Stores** – Trade‑in or consignment. | Different audiences mean different exposure levels. | | **7️⃣ Set Pricing Strategy** | • Fixed Price vs Auction: Auctions can create urgency but may undercut value.
• Add a small buffer (~$10–$20) above your target price so you’re willing to negotiate slightly. | Flexibility attracts both serious buyers and bargain hunters. | | **8️⃣ Decide Shipping Options** | • Offer free shipping (include cost in price).
• Provide multiple carrier choices (USPS, UPS, FedEx).
• Ship within sturdy padded case with foam inserts. | Proper packaging reduces return rates and builds reputation. | | **9️⃣ Safety Tips for In‑Person Sales** | • Meet in public places (coffee shop, police station parking lot).
• Bring a friend or family member.
• Accept cash only or use secure payment apps like Venmo/E‑Transfer. | Protects you from scams and ensures safe transactions. | | 🔟 Finalize & Follow Up | Once sold, ship promptly. Send tracking number via email/SMS. Ask for feedback/review. | Good service leads to positive ratings → future sales boost. | --- ### Quick Checklist | ✔️ Item | Notes | |---------|-------| | 🎸 Instrument Type | Acoustic guitar | | 📦 Packaging | Hard shell case + protective padding | | 💰 Target Price | $X (based on market research) | | 🗓️ Sale Date | ASAP — keep listing active until sold | | 🚚 Shipping Carrier | USPS Priority Mail Flat Rate Box recommended | | 🌐 Platforms | Reverb, eBay, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, local store | #### Example Listing Title: ``` Fender CD-60S Acoustic Guitar - Excellent Condition, 2009, Natural Finish, Includes Case & Strap ``` #### Sample Description Snippet: ``` This Fender CD-60S was purchased new in 2010 and has been kept in a climate-controlled environment. All components are original, including the neck pickup and steel strings. Minor cosmetic wear on the back panel due to occasional handling. Comes with a standard black gig bag and a vintage-style leather strap. Perfect for beginners or seasoned players looking for reliable tone without breaking the bank. ``` Feel free to tweak this template to match your specific guitar’s attributes. Happy selling!
message.reasoning:
The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to provide guidance: listing platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), condition assessment, pricing research, photos, description, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention local music stores trade-in programs.

We don't have to call the tool because it's about tuning an instrument; not relevant here. So just respond with helpful info.
